title: Rust: ACK generation + processing
description: Implement ACK generation and processing in Rust. Acceptance: generates correct ACKs, cross-validates with Python.
notes: Completed Rust SCHC ACK generation/processing verification and fixes. Corrected canonical trailing-one restoration across the W/C octet boundary, preserved W on C=0 serialization, accepted canonical two-byte compressed C=0 ACKs, and bounded ACK wire length. Shared schc_adaptation ACK vectors now drive Ack parse/write directly. Added exhaustive trailing-one boundary, all-zero/all-one, invalid-size, Rule ID, and final-window tests. Green: cargo test -p lichen-schc --all-features; cargo clippy -p lichen-schc --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo check -p lichen-schc --no-default-features; cargo fmt -p lichen-schc --check; Python ACK parity tests 3 passed.
close_reason: Implemented and verified complete Rust SCHC ACK bitmap generation and processing with shared-vector and edge coverage; all package, lint, fmt, no_std, and targeted Python parity gates pass.
